Subject: Hosted API evaluation - next steps and quickstart

Hi Sam / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the call today — really appreciated the time. Quick recap from our demo and proposed next steps so we can get you evaluating the Hosted API quickly: 

What we demoed
- Hosted API endpoints (streaming + non-streaming) for text generation, chat, and embeddings
- Quickstart with sample keys and a sandbox dataset
- Observability: per-route latency and token cost breakdowns in the Console

Your priorities we heard
- Low friction evaluation to validate latency and output quality for your chat flows
- Clarification on data residency (EU) and compliance posture
- Expected concurrency and rate needs for an initial pilot (~50 concurrent users, bursts to ~200 req/min)

Recommended immediate next steps
1) Quickstart kit: we can spin up sandbox credentials and a temporary higher rate limit for evaluation. See attached quickstart guide (redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf).
2) Regional endpoints: we have EU-hosted endpoints available for evaluation; if you need strict data residency + audit controls we can discuss Dedicated or Private options.
3) Schedule a 45-min hands-on quickstart session where we walk through endpoints, sample prompts, and perf checks.

Notes on Hosted API rate limits (baseline)
- Developer tier: 60 req/min per API key
- Pro / eval boosted: 600 req/min with higher concurrency options (we can enable a temporary increase for the pilot)
- Embeddings: typically measured in tokens/sec; concurrent embeddings behave like separate request streams — we can provide a trial concurrency bump for 24–72 hours.

If you confirm a good time for the quickstart (I have availability Tue/Wed mornings PST), I’ll have Marissa and Neha assigned to the session to help with instrumentation and perf checks.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in your hands.

Best,
Aditya Rao

Thanks Aditya — great demo. A couple quick clarifications before we schedule the hands-on: 

1) Data residency: does the Hosted API offer EU-only processing and at-rest storage? Our security team requires EU data residency for PII.
2) Rate limits: you mentioned a temporary bump for evaluations — can you confirm what sustained throughput we could expect for chat (messages per second + tokens/sec)? We have a mix of short chat (~30 tokens) and longer generation (~300 tokens) calls.
3) Trial credits: do you provide any credits or a time-limited eval account to help us run overnight load tests?

Also looping in Elena (our infra lead) — she’ll likely ask about network allowlists and whether we can bind keys to IP ranges.

Appreciate it — Sam

Hi Sam / Elena — following up with specifics to help your security and infra teams: 

Data residency / EU handling
- We support regional Hosted endpoints. For EU residency we can provision an EU-only project (requests, logs, and persistence remain in-region). This is the standard path for customers not yet ready for Dedicated/Private. If you require customer-managed keys or on-premise storage, that’s when Private VPC/on-prem is recommended.

Rate limits & throughput guidance
- Baseline dev keys: 60 req/min per key.
- Eval boost (what we can enable for your pilot): configurable — we commonly enable up to 1,000 req/min for short trials and can support ~100 concurrent streaming chat connections for 24–72 hours to validate latency.
- Token throughput: with our default hosted configs you should expect ~30–50 response tokens/sec per GPU-backed endpoint under typical load; actual throughput depends on model and sequence length. We’ll help you pick a model profile that matches your latency goals.

Network controls & security
- API keys can be restricted to IP ranges and rotated programmatically.
- Audit logs and request traces are available via the Console; retention is configurable (add-on).

Trial credits / next steps
- We can issue evaluation credits and a 72-hour elevated-rate trial. I’ve attached a draft SOW that outlines scope if you want it as a starting point.

Proposed slot for quickstart: Wed, Mar 17 at 10:00 AM PT (if that works for you we’ll send a calendar invite and pre-configure the sandbox).

Let us know and we’ll schedule the hands-on session and provision the EU project for you to test residency.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
